verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server exposing tools (listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest, etc.) that map to Deel API operations, with OAuth2 auto-handled by clients like Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and ChatGPT, and compatibility with any MCP-over-HTTP client. This is well-documented first-party evidence with no independent hands-on corroboration found. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working in practice, broader community validation.
